svg.title: ASPIRE complete workflow
svg.desc: Conceptual workflow based on ASPIRE main commit 9fb77afd2bc87c100fadb1f1b02ee8b984d3ee8c. Core read processing, ASV generation and taxonomy feed non-target screening and metadata tables. Optional three-tier decontamination uses raw control-bearing counts and metadata to flag pooled prevalence, within-type frequency and biological plausibility, filtering the long and wide tables before downstream analyses. Group diagnostics and batch correction feed ecological, patient-aware association and network analyses, including topology null tests and genome linkage. Parallel branches are shown where analyses share inputs. Numbered modules group operations rather than prescribe an execution schedule. The wrapper publishes results and the run report after successful execution.
svg.metadata: Source: hallamlab/ASPIRE main, 9fb77afd2bc87c100fadb1f1b02ee8b984d3ee8c; asv_pipeline.nf, README.md, run_asv_pipeline.sh. Diagram created 2026-10-03.

text.tspan: ASPIRE + Nextflow • Core, standard and optional workflow tiers
run_asv_pipeline.sh • YAML configuration • Mamba environments • Resource requests • Resume and stage-aware reruns
Core: amplicon FASTQs, sample IDs / manifest and taxonomy references
As enabled: metadata, controls / DNA concentrations, screening references,
VOCs, genomes / barrnap outputs, or supplied network files
¹ External MITOMASTER lookup is optional; local screens can run without it.
Scores use raw control-bearing counts; downstream tables receive the removals. Plausibility rules target airway studies.
² Patient-aware testing and ordination depend on configuration.
Relative abundance is primary; CLR provides sensitivity analysis. Observation gates and permutations are configurable.
